openalex-w7204480187: A swollen gallbladder can rot, and surgeons now often take it out through small cuts even in bad cases. This paper sums up what studies say about keyhole gallbladder removal for severe sudden inflammation. The authors weigh safety and results. A surgery review tracking how far the small-cut method has come.
arxiv-2606-15987: Ancient manuscripts written in Sahidic Coptic — the main dialect of late ancient Egypt — are hard for computers to read. This paper releases a labeled dataset of these texts so researchers can train models to recognize the old handwriting. It is a building block for digitizing and preserving Egypt's early Christian-era written heritage.
arxiv-2606-16087: A graph theory paper on strong connectivity — when every point in a network can reach every other — and strong biconnectivity, a tougher version that survives the loss of any single connection. The author works through problems related to these properties, which matter for designing resilient communication networks. It targets specialists in graph algorithms.
arxiv-2606-16187: "Oblivious" programs hide not just your data but your access patterns — what you looked at and when — from anyone watching. obliv-clang brings this strong privacy property to real-world C++ programming as a practical compiler toolchain. The paper targets security engineers who need cryptographic privacy guarantees in software people actually run.
arxiv-2606-16487: Most statistics assumes well-behaved data, but real risks — market crashes, floods — come from heavy tails. This probability paper studies logarithmic large deviations for sums of heavy-tailed variables: how rare, extreme totals behave. It targets probabilists and risk modelers working where the normal distribution fails.
arxiv-2606-16587: Spray nozzles — in engines, printers, farm equipment — break liquid sheets into droplets, and simulating that breakup is brutally expensive. This paper learns a geometry-conditioned latent surrogate: a fast AI stand-in that predicts spray formation from the nozzle's shape. It targets engineers who need spray simulations without supercomputer bills.
arxiv-2606-16787: Gas giant exoplanets have wild atmospheres where tiny clusters of metal oxides may form — seeds of clouds. This paper studies those clusters: how they form and what they do in hot Jupiter-like skies. It is for astronomers modeling alien atmospheres.
arxiv-2606-16887: Tiny drums where light and jiggle wed are called optomechanical cavities. This paper weds two bending drums with built jiggle links, so the pair hums as one. It is for optomechanics pros who link light and motion. Linked drums sing together.
